subtitle: Build muscle at 55: gym on Monday and Friday, dumbbell and bench workouts at home on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, and yoga with 15 minutes of meditation every morning.
safety: Check with the doctor before starting heavy lifting, especially if any medicine dose has changed recently.
Blood sugar: if your medicines can lower blood sugar, check sugar before lifting and keep glucose tablets nearby. Lift 1 to 3 hours after a meal, not fasted.
Form before weight. Stop each set with 1 or 2 good reps left. Breathe out as you lift; never hold your breath.
Add weight slowly: when you can do the top of the rep range for every set with good form, go up 1 to 2 kg next time.
On the bench, use a weight you can control over the face and chest. Don't train to failure alone.
Yoga: move only to a comfortable stretch, never into pain. Full shoulder stand and headstand are left out on purpose.
Stop for sharp joint pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness. Call for an ambulance for chest pain or pressure, fainting, sudden weakness or trouble speaking.
Sleep 7 to 8 hours. Muscles are built during rest.

days.name: Mon
days.note: Morning yoga and meditation at home, then the gym.

tiles.title: Hips & hamstrings
tiles.tip: First thing in the morning, on an empty stomach (the morning tablet with water is fine). Breathe through the nose and never push into pain.

moves.name: Easy seated breathing
moves.tip: Sit tall, slow breaths through the nose. Notice how the body feels today.

moves.name: Cat-cow (Marjaryasana-Bitilasana)
moves.tip: Move with the breath to warm up the spine.

moves.name: Surya Namaskar, slow
moves.tip: Bend the knees in the forward folds. Step back, don't jump.

moves.name: Low lunge (Anjaneyasana)
moves.tip: Pad the back knee. Sink the hips forward gently.

moves.name: Half split (Ardha Hanumanasana)
moves.tip: Hands on blocks or books. Back flat, front leg long.

moves.name: Bound angle (Baddha Konasana)
moves.tip: Sit on a folded blanket so the back stays tall.

moves.name: Head-to-knee pose (Janu Sirsasana)
moves.tip: Fold from the hips, not the upper back.

moves.name: Reclined hand-to-big-toe (Supta Padangusthasana)
moves.tip: Use a strap or towel around the foot.

moves.name: Bridge (Setu Bandhasana)
moves.tip: Opens the front of the hips and the chest.

moves.name: Shavasana (corpse pose)
moves.tip: Lie still and let the whole body go heavy before the meditation.

tiles.title: Breath meditation (Anapana), 15 minutes
tiles.tip: Sit tall on a cushion or chair. Rest attention on the breath at the nostrils; when the mind wanders, come back.

tiles.title: Instructor's routine
tiles.tip: Your instructor sets the workout. Some reminders:

moves.name: Tell the instructor
moves.tip: Your age, any health conditions, and that you do home workouts on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, so the gym days can fill the gaps.

moves.name: Warm up
moves.tip: Treadmill walk or cycle, then light sets.

moves.name: Pack
moves.tip: Water bottle, glucose tablets or a small fruit, and a towel.

moves.name: Log your lifts
moves.tip: Write down weights and reps so you can add a little each week.

moves.name: Walk after
moves.tip: An easy walk afterwards helps bring the blood sugar down.

days.name: Tue

tiles.title: Shoulders & chest

moves.name: Easy seated breathing
moves.tip: Sit tall, slow breaths through the nose. Notice how the body feels today.

moves.name: Thread the needle
moves.tip: Opens the upper back after pressing days.

moves.name: Puppy pose (Uttana Shishosana)
moves.tip: Hips over the knees, chest melts down.

moves.name: Cow-face arms (Gomukhasana arms)
moves.tip: Hold a strap or towel if the hands don't meet.

moves.name: Camel, supported (Ustrasana)
moves.tip: Hands on the lower back, hips forward. Skip if the neck or back complains.

moves.name: Fish pose, supported (Matsyasana)
moves.tip: Lie back over a rolled blanket or block under the upper back.

moves.name: Shavasana (corpse pose)
moves.tip: Lie still and let the whole body go heavy before the meditation.

tiles.title: Body scan meditation, 15 minutes
tiles.tip: Move attention slowly from the toes to the head, relaxing each part. Good on lifting days.

tiles.title: Full body A: dumbbells & bench
tiles.tip: Rest 90 sec between sets on big lifts, 60 sec on small ones.

moves.name: Warm-up
moves.tip: Brisk marching, arm circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 hip hinges, then one light set of the first exercise.
moves.q: full body warm up before weight training

moves.name: Goblet squat
moves.tip: Hold one dumbbell at the chest. Sit down between the heels, chest up.

moves.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
moves.tip: Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched. Lower slowly for 2 to 3 seconds.

moves.name: One-arm dumbbell row
moves.tip: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat. Pull the elbow to the hip.
moves.q: one arm dumbbell row bench form

moves.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
moves.tip: Push the hips back, dumbbells close to the legs, back flat.

moves.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
moves.tip: Bench upright. Don't arch the lower back.

moves.name: Biceps curl + overhead triceps extension
moves.tip: Do them back to back, then rest.

moves.name: Dead bug
moves.tip: Lower back stays pressed into the floor.

moves.name: Cool-down
moves.tip: Easy walk around the house, then stretch the muscles you worked.

moves.name: Triangle (Trikonasana)

moves.name: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)

moves.name: Pyramid pose (Parsvottanasana)
moves.tip: Hands on blocks; stretches the hamstrings.

moves.tip: Strap around the feet; keep the back long rather than reaching far.

moves.name: Foam roll or easy stretching

moves.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row

moves.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
moves.tip: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on the hips. Squeeze the glutes at the top.

moves.name: Lateral raise
moves.tip: Light weight, lift to shoulder height, no swinging.

moves.name: Hammer curl + lying triceps extension
moves.tip: Lying extension on the bench, lower the dumbbells beside the head.

moves.name: Side plank
moves.tip: From the knees if needed.

moves.name: Standing calf raise
moves.tip: Hold dumbbells, pause at the top.

moves.name: Cool-down
moves.tip: Easy walk around the house, then stretch the muscles you worked.
